Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Even if there are sloppy conditions, the washer keeps the camera's view clean. Rear camera with washer is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe
Technology and Telematics

    • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. description: GR Auto Gallery is excited to present this 1996 Chevrolet Caprice Wagon finished in Light Sandrift Metallic, a subtle and classy color that fits the long, sweeping body lines of this full size wagon perfectly. The final generation Caprice wagon has a presence all its own with its extended roofline and unmistakable rear profile, capped off by the highly desirable dual swivel tailgate. It is a true throwback to when family cars were big, comfortable, and unapologetically American. Under the hood sits the legendary 5.7L LT1 V8 paired with a 4-speed automatic transmission. This is the same basic engine platform that powered the Corvette and Camaro of the era, giving this wagon performance that surprises just about everyone. The LT1 delivers strong low end torque and smooth highway cruising, making it equally at home hauling the family or stretching its legs on an open road. For those who know, the LT1 powered Caprice wagons have developed a loyal following thanks to their durability and unexpected muscle. Inside, the tan cloth interior creates a warm and inviting cabin that is all about comfort. Power windows, locks, mirrors, and a power seat add everyday convenience, while interior wood trim brings a touch of classic 90s upscale styling. The spacious layout offers generous room for passengers and cargo alike, and with working air conditioning and heat, it is ready for year round enjoyment. The dual action tailgate is one of the wagon’s best features, opening traditionally or swinging out to make loading and unloading effortless. The 1996 model year marked the end of the line for the traditional rear wheel drive Chevrolet Caprice, making these wagons increasingly collectible. They represent the last of the big body on frame American family haulers, combining V8 power, rear wheel drive, and unmatched practicality in one package. Whether you are looking for a unique daily driver, a future collectible, or a nostalgic cruiser with real performance under the hood, this Caprice Wagon stands out in all the right ways. Please call or email us today for more information.

The addition of the rearview camera and other available safety packages on Plus and higher trims enhances confidence on the road. With **Wireless audio streaming** and **Wireless connectivity**, you can effortlessly enjoy your favorite music and podcasts. The integration of your mobile device with the vehicle’s sound system ensures that your entertainment needs are met without any hassle.
